method: Compact evidence packets; broader short-body filter with <=30 lifted lines, <=40 combined loads/stores, and >=1 accepted semantic callee; ten parallel producers x five targets; independent QA of every nonblank plus deterministic blank sampling; serial merge and single index refresh.
notes: Actual Luna-low override was set for all producer and reviewer subagents.
No token meter was available, so token savings cannot be quantified.
13/50 names were accepted; the broader candidate window increased throughput but lowered accepted-name yield.
Blank names remain blank; no prototype or field claims were made.
